stem: Applying a paste of baking soda (a mild base) on a bee sting (which is acidic) helps relieve the pain. This works because an acid and a base react together to form a salt and water, cancelling out each other's properties — a reaction called:
explanation: Neutralisation is the reaction between an acid and a base, producing salt and water and cancelling their acidic/basic properties — a common household application being relief from acidic insect stings using a mild base.
